events.name: China GDP (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Quarterly change in China's real output; the broadest gauge of growth in the world's second-largest economy.

events.name: China Retail Sales (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Year-on-year change in Chinese consumer spending, a key read on domestic demand strength.

events.name: China 1-Year Loan Prime Rate
events.description: PBoC benchmark lending rate for new loans; signals the stance of Chinese monetary policy.

events.name: UK Unemployment Rate
events.description: Share of the UK labour force without work; influences BoE rate and wage-growth expectations.

events.name: UK CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Annual change in UK consumer prices, the BoE's main inflation gauge and a driver of rate expectations.

events.name: New Zealand CPI (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Quarterly change in New Zealand consumer prices; guides RBNZ policy and NZ dollar direction.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new US unemployment benefit filings; a timely indicator of labour market health.

events.name: US Leading Index (M-o-M)
events.description: Composite of forward-looking US indicators, used to gauge the economic outlook.

events.name: US Manufacturing PMI (Flash)
events.description: Preliminary S&P Global survey of US factory activity; readings above 50 signal expansion.

events.name: Eurozone Services PMI (Flash)
events.description: Preliminary S&P Global survey of Eurozone service-sector activity; an early read on growth and ECB policy.
